title: Netflix Announces Release Date for 'Love Is Blind: Netherlands - The Reunion'
summary: The countdown to the reunion of 'Love Is Blind: Netherlands' has begun! During the reunion, the cast will come together again for the first time, and we’ll finally get answers to all our questions.
body_markdown:
Entertainment

Global


Netherlands


Link copied to clipboard


The countdown to the reunion of


Love Is Blind: Netherlands


has begun! During the reunion, the cast will come together again for the first time, and we’ll finally get answers to all our questions. Get ready for surprising revelations, emotional reunions, and somewhat heated confrontations.


Love Is Blind: Netherlands


- The Reunion


airs Sunday, October 18 at 6 p.m. CEST on Netflix.


The cast got to know each other in the so-called ‘pods’, rooms separated from one another by a thin wall. The engaged couples then traveled to Zanzibar, lived together in the Netherlands, and some of them eventually stood at the altar to decide whether to say ‘I do.’ But what happened after the cameras stopped rolling? During the reunion, hosted by Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit, the cast look back on their romantic adventures.


Hosts:


Nicolette van Dam en Bas Smit


Production company:


Fremantle
